title: Prompt Injection & Jailbreaks — Authorize Actions Outside the Model
key_insight: Application code should validate tool arguments and authorize each action from the signed-in user, resource, and policy.
body:
## Authorize Actions Outside the Model

The model confidently asks to email a private file. Confidence is not permission.

Application code should validate tool arguments and authorize each action from the signed-in user, resource, and policy.

Use least-privilege tools and require confirmation for important writes. Retrieved text must never grant itself more authority.
common_mistakes: A confident model request proves authorization.
Retrieved documents should be allowed to grant permissions.
mini_exercise: Draw “Authorize Actions Outside the Model” as three steps and explain each one.
real_world_usage: Applications must treat model-readable content as untrusted because text can attempt to redirect instructions and tools.
explain_back_prompt: Use “Authorize Actions Outside the Model” to explain Prompt Injection & Jailbreaks plainly.
